name: herdr-brain
description: Herdr Monitor: a durable record of work items, runs, reports and zero-inference status outside any LLM session.

scripts.test:promotion: node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion -- npm run test:promotion:steps
scripts.test: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:cycle --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:cycle
scripts.test:promotion:steps: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:lanes --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:lanes && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:logic --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:logic

refused|a replacement PID|slow Herdr|housekeeping gives|queue and notice locks|inbox fixture teardown|owned inbox teardown|(?:exhausted|refused) (?:start|prepare|commit) replies|loaded transaction|provider selection|alternative profiles|entry reserves|(?:claude|codex): captured ANSI|compound styles|Codex includes|interruption requires|repository does not track|answers are passed as an argument array|a missing configuration becomes an example|retry context and cutover aggregate preserve|cleanup closes main and linked workspaces after|failed inventory still attempts every owned console/test/session.test.mjs acceptance/test/load-round2.test.mjs acceptance/test/cleanup.test.mjs acceptance/test/cutover.test.mjs acceptance/test/focus.test.mjs acceptance/test/recovery.test.mjs discovery/test/owner.test.mjs discovery/test/review-r2.test.mjs discovery/test/review-r3.test.mjs dispatch/test/dispatch.test.mjs housekeeping/test/auto-tidy.test.mjs watch/test/watch.test.mjs
scripts.test:release:steps: npm test && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:lanes --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:lanes && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:acceptance --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:acceptance && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:release:only --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:release:only
scripts.test:promotion:lanes: node test/helpers/run.mjs --test-name-pattern='^(promote (refuses|leaves|rebases|accepts)|close (deletes|retires|refuses|preserves)|open refuses (symlink|ordinary)|registered paths are rejected|same-named repositories|a repository with a separate git directory|failed archive and post-close metadata|selected malformed, unreadable, and wrongly typed config|linked invocations use canonical repository config|bare repositories with only linked worktrees)' lanes/test/lane.test.mjs
